description: Configuration for context-loader.js (Context Management Layer, framework 1.5.0). Repository-specific knobs only; loader logic and canonical loading policy live elsewhere (Knowledge Separation, ../CLAUDE.md; canonical policy constitution/CONTEXT_ARTIFACTS.md §8). Names paths and the token-cost ESTIMATE model; never restates what to load.

tokenModel.note: ESTIMATE ONLY: ceil(fileBytes / bytesPerToken). A deterministic byte proxy for RELATIVE reduction reporting — NOT a tokenizer measurement. Never presented as an authoritative token count.

universe.note: The naive full-load baseline against which reduction is estimated: every authoritative document a non-manifest boot would read.
